name: github
description: Reads GitHub for what is waiting on you and what you are waiting on: review requests, your PRs' reviews and checks, mentions and assigned issues. Read-only.

waiting-on-me.prompt: Use the waiting-on-me skill to find what is waiting on me on GitHub.

waiting-on-them.prompt: Use the waiting-on-them skill to find what I am waiting on others for on GitHub.

action-now.prompt: Use the waiting-on-me and action-now-or-soon skills to answer action-now: what I need to act on today on GitHub.

action-soon.prompt: Use the waiting-on-me and action-now-or-soon skills to answer action-soon: what I need to act on soon on GitHub.

my-commitments.prompt: Use the my-commitments skill to find the promises I made on GitHub: what I said I would do, to whom, the date and whether I appear to have done it. Take the period from the caller; default to the last 14 days.

catch-up.prompt: Use the catch-up skill to catch me up on one conversation, thread or topic on GitHub: where it stands, what happened and what is open. Take the subject from the caller; if none is given, ask for one.

find.prompt: Use the find skill to find what the caller asks for on GitHub (something someone said, a number, an address, a plan) and name where and when. Take the search from the caller; if none is given, ask for one.

all.prompt: Answer all four triage questions on GitHub, following triage-report: action-now, action-soon, waiting-on-them, then the counts.
